fields.description:
**PLACEHOLDER — raised 2026-09-01, needs design before build.**

## Requirement

A rep-facing "My Assignments" view on Deal Rep Assignment, scoped to the running user's own assignments. Under each assignment the rep should see:

* the Sign-Ups attributed to that assignment
* affiliate link(s) for the assignment
* key Deal info — whatever is permissible for reps to see

## Design note — this is not a plain list view

A standard Salesforce list view is flat: it cannot nest child Sign-Ups under each parent assignment row. Three ways to deliver the requirement:

* **Option A — list view + record page (smallest change).** A "My Assignments" DRA list view filtered to _My records_ (or Rep = current user) with the key assignment/deal columns, and the Sign-Ups + Affiliate Links related lists on the DRA record page. Rep drills in one click to see children. Config only.
* **Option B — grouped report.** Summary report on Sign-Up grouped by Deal Rep Assignment, filtered to My Assignments. Shows parent and children on one screen, but reads like a report, not a workspace.
* **Option C — LWC on the Rep Home Page.** Accordion of assignments, each expanding to its Sign-Ups and links. Best UX, most build, and overlaps the existing Rep Home Page POC.

**Recommend starting with Option A** and only building C if reps say the drill-in is too slow — A is config, ships this phase, and the columns chosen for it are reusable by B or C later.

## Open questions

* Which Deal fields are rep-permissible? Needs the same field list as the rep read-only work (see BUILD-256).
* Filter by record owner or by an explicit Rep lookup on DRA? Ownership model on DRA is still open.
* Does the rep need Sign-Up counts/status rollups at the assignment level, or the individual Sign-Up records?
* Sizing TBD once the option is picked.
fields.summary: BUILD-257 — Rep "My Assignments" view: assignments with Sign-Ups and key assignment/deal info
